chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn Ūramah, from ʿAlī ibn Maysarah, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The husband has the greater right concerning his wife until he places her in her grave.”

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: more entitled; having the stronger claim or priority

ai.seo_question: Does a husband have priority regarding his wife's burial rites in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the husband holds the primary right regarding his wife in the matters connected to her after death, up to her burial. It is cited in the context of funeral rulings and the handling of the deceased.
